vintage.rail: SNCF Réseau official active-line shapes; Natural Earth v5.1.2 retained only for Corsica

rules.roads: Natural Earth European-route/motorway lines form class 0; major highways and expressways at scale rank 7 or better form class 1. Geometry is schematic map art, not a complete road inventory.
rules.rail: Official active SNCF Réseau line sections: ordinary lines form main lines and connections/main/port tracks form secondary lines. Natural Earth is retained only for Corsica because it is outside the RFN export.
rules.ports: Eurostat ports reporting metric tonnes handled in 2023, positioned by Natural Earth or their namesake commune.
rules.airports: Metropolitan airports with at least 20,000 passengers on board in 2023. Hub letters are local display-size buckets.
rules.stations: Passenger stations with at least 250,000 passengers in 2025. SNCF changed the traffic methodology in 2025, so values are not directly comparable with 2015–2024.
